checks.name: Review is read-only and consumes the same frozen plan used by apply
No-write confirmation commits the selected input without fabricating history
Original duplicate protection does not claim current duplicate copies exist
Shared explanation identifies protection without invented application ownership
Continuity-protected partial apply keeps intent and factual history
Conflict blocks all target writes and exposes an actionable explanation
Unsupported append blocks the batch even when its own value needs no operation
Revoke remains a scope explanation with no executable action
Target index merges the same canonical target and separates User/System Path
Target navigation changes only reading position and focus
Returning to workbench preserves exact input, baseline, state and batch selection
Workbench review action preserves the visible batch confirmation scope
Real selection and clear actions keep review scope label current without replacing the draft
View comparison is focusable without editing the selected value
Returning to a replace context does not open a forbidden element editor
Refresh preserves raw disclosure and focus by canonical target
Cross-version token focus falls back to its target, never a guessed occurrence
Pure presentation redraw preserves the focused token in the correct region
Updated preview still requires review and separate final confirmation
Unrelated snapshot changes do not invalidate review
Closing after a trigger redraw restores focus to its replacement
More issue details and raw values are escaped without changing frozen data
No runtime errors in review workflows
